CLEANUP_RULE.PROCEDURE: stop only this exact unit if still active or observer cap/deadline fails; within25s budget. Verify no active tasks, no persistent unit, no /run/systemd/transient/<unit>; collect or empty/remove cgroup state read-only. Never reset attempt receipt. Cleanup error secondary to first failure; no relaunch.

FIELD_BINDINGS.OBSERVATION_PROVENANCE: raw service snapshots plus independent manager/kernel/parent captures with actual times
FIELD_BINDINGS.SERVICE_EXIT_STATUS: independent manager/parent outcome; no success inferred from collection or service self-report
FIELD_BINDINGS.SERVICE_PROCESS_ID: payload SERVICE_PID independently matches manager MainPID and host /proc/<PID>/cgroup
FIELD_BINDINGS.SERVICE_SYSTEMD_CGROUP: separately captured own name=systemd path, never used as pids substitute

RAW_FRAMING.RULE: Decode complete raw JSON records using the exact source-defined separator; preserve raw bytes and timestamps.
